disclaimer: Neither a diagnosis nor a prescription. Material for a conversation with a doctor.

snapshot.label: Resting pulse
snapshot.note: A rising resting pulse while ferritin falls is not a coincidence.

sections.title: Movement
sections.lead: Four runs a week, the volume steady for the third year. The problem is not the load but the fact that the iron store does not recover under it.

sections.title: Food
sections.lead: Vegetarian for the fifth year, with no B12 monitoring until 2024. Non-haem iron is absorbed worse, and tea straight after a meal does not help that.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.lead: Seven and a half hours on average, a steady schedule. There is no separate task for sleep — this is the case where the layer is looked at and left alone.

actions: Iron every other day on an empty stomach with vitamin C — that is absorbed better than daily.
Space the levothyroxine and the omeprazole apart in the time of dosing.
Albumin and alkaline phosphatase at the next draw — without them the biological age series does not build.
dropped: «add red meat» — the lever does not apply to a vegetarian, kept as rejected
